F1.evidence: No hue ramps exist to capture: the shadcn layer resolves 44 semantic roles per theme and a flat chart.1-5 set, plus literal brand oranges (#ea580d/#ff6900/#f54900 family) declared as single roles, not ~10-step scales per hue.

F2.evidence: Real surface ladder in both themes: root.background, color.page, card.default, popover.default, sidebar.background, canvas.default and accent/muted wells, resolved from --background/--color-page/--card/--popover/--sidebar/--canvas on :root and .dark.

F3.evidence: foreground, muted.foreground, card/popover/secondary/accent foregrounds and primary.foreground (on-accent ink) resolve per theme. No dedicated disabled or link text role exists in the layer; links paint through foreground/accent.

F4.evidence: border.default, border.input and border.ring (focus, #ff6900/#f54900) plus sidebar.border resolve per theme. No 'strong' border step ships; emphasis borders reuse the ring literal or rgba() white hairlines in dark.

F5.evidence: Each semantic fill ships a single default step (primary/secondary/accent/muted/destructive/sidebar/upgrade). Hover and pressed fills are painted per component, not declared as hover/pressed token steps, so there is no default/hover/pressed ladder to tokenise.

F6.evidence: Only destructive.default (#e7000b light, #ff6467 dark) exists as a status role. No success/warning/info family ships in the captured layer; chart.1-5 are data-viz literals, not status sets with fill/text/border variants.

F7.evidence: 44 token names resolve identically in light (:root) and dark (.dark / html.dark data-theme=dark), 154 custom properties resolved per theme; the dark set is real (app login repaints under prefers-color-scheme: dark, nested .dark sections on marketing pages).

F8.evidence: font.family.sans (Inter + Inter Fallback), geistMono and mono stacks; 10 sizes xs-7xl, 4 weights, 13 line heights, 5 tracking steps; plus 7 typography composites (articleTitle, body, navLink, button, input, oauthButton, tabLabel) each with family/size/weight/line-height/tracking. bodyLink and faqQuestion were withdrawn: those readings were the breadcrumb and the header Solutions trigger.

F9.evidence: space.unit (0.25rem, the Tailwind 4px base) and layout.sectionPadding/sectionGap/cardGap are tokenised, but the product declares no numbered spacing scale; component paddings are measured per entry in raw/measurements.md.

F10.evidence: Named radius scale xs/base/lg/md/xl/2xl (0.125rem-1rem) resolved from --radius-* vars plus per-component radii (button 12px, input 9999px, testimonial 16px, loginCard 0px); border widths measured per component entry.

F11.evidence: Control heights measured (cta 40px, secondary 32px, oauth 40px, inputs 36/48px, header 64px, tab 57px) and the focus ring colour is tokenised (border.ring), but the ring's width/offset are not declared in the harvested vars and were not invented.

F12.evidence: No shadow scale ships: the stylesheet harvest declares box-shadow only as literal one-off values on a few components (captured in measurements), there is no named elevation ladder to tokenise.

F13.evidence: Durations (20 steps 70ms-22s incl. marquee lengths), 10 easing curves and named animations (hero-reveal 600ms, enter 300ms, scattered-scroll, clients-stack, ping/pulse/spin) are tokenised from declared keyframes and transition vars. raw/motion.json records the reduced-motion probe on five pages (/, /pricing, /features, /mcp, the login): behaviour partial, 209 moving, 10 removed, 197 kept; /pricing, /features and the login ignore the preference and the marquee/ping loops keep running.
